tagline: Lorenz取景器相机，1926 年发布
description: Lorenz于1926年推出的取景器相机。

specs.英文简介: The Nacht Kamera is more-or-less a copy of Ernemann's Ermanox, made by Ernst Lorenz of Berlin in about 1926; a hand-held camera with a large-aperture lens of portrait length, and a focal plane shutter, designed to allow photography in poor light; both cameras' names refer to night-time.
